thread.title: Subtle Negatives Lurk Beneath the Market's Surface

title: Subtle Negatives Lurk Beneath the Market's Surface
text:
Subtle Negatives Lurk Beneath the Market's Surface By aapl
The pattern of the market action recently has been strong underlying support but limited upside momentum. Tuesday the buying support was even better than what we've seen lately, as a large gap-down open was quickly bought and led to the best day of upside action in the past week.
Under the surface, things were not quite as positive. Breadth was negative, although that was offset by strength in big-cap technology and Apple ( AAPL ) , in particular. Also, as I discussed in my previous post , there was an unusual number of new 12-month lows. It is uncommon for new lows to expand to more than 380 on a day when the indices are in the green.
While the technical picture of the major indices looks quite good, the underlying action and the potential for negative seasonality is a problem. Money rotated into the safety of some larger-cap stocks Tuesday but there was plenty of choppy and mixed action in individual names. It was easy to be in the wrong stocks today.
Wednesday there will be endless coverage of the Apple new product event but if the weak internal action continues it may be a problem. There isn't anything blaringly negative. However, this market lacks strong momentum and at some point that could lead to trouble. Get an email alert each time I write an article for Real Money.
